title: Open Problems in Integrable Systems — Nijenhuis operators: singular points and global properties
exact_target: Which closed manifolds admit a Nijenhuis tensor that is algebraically regular everywhere, allowing both nontrivial Jordan blocks and complex eigenvalues?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2100508 (AMR-020-0508). CC BY 4.0.

Alexey Bolsinov, Vladimir S. Matveev, Eva Miranda and Serge Tabachnikov, Open Problems, Questions, and Challenges in Finite-Dimensional Integrable Systems (2018), Problem 5.10 and its complete preceding definitions. Original question and full discussion.
